task.description:
Validate the Stage F7 - Tenant Onboarding GUI requirements (ONB-UI-01 through ONB-UI-04) that REQ-ANALYST just added to docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md.

Run the completeness and consistency checks from WF-01 Step 2:
- Each requirement has a unique ID, priority, stage, and GIVEN/THEN acceptance criteria
- No requirement conflicts with existing requirements
- All referenced API endpoints exist in the codebase (check src/api/routes/onboarding.zig)
- Role guard (PLATFORM_ADMIN) is consistent with the permission matrix (IDN-03)
- Behaviour-only: no implementation code leaked into requirement text
- ONB-UI-02 form fields cover all required fields of POST /api/v1/onboarding
- ONB-UI-03 polling is consistent with GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id response schema

PASS only if all checks clear. FAIL with specific issues otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: PASS: all four requirements are complete, consistent, and unambiguous
FAIL: specific issues listed with severity and suggested fix

result.summary: All four ONB-UI-01 through ONB-UI-04 requirements pass completeness and consistency checks; one MINOR issue noted in ONB-UI-03 (missing explicit PLATFORM_ADMIN role guard statement).

issues.description: ONB-UI-03 does not explicitly state that the progress display is restricted to PLATFORM_ADMIN. The prose and all five acceptance criteria omit a role-guard clause. The backend code (handleGetOnboarding) enforces PLATFORM_ADMIN at the API layer, and the user can only reach this screen via ONB-UI-02 (which is PLATFORM_ADMIN-only), but the requirement text itself should explicitly state the role restriction for unambiguity and test traceability. Suggested fix: add 'Only a PLATFORM_ADMIN may view the progress display' to the ONB-UI-03 prose, and add a criterion: 'GIVEN a user without the PLATFORM_ADMIN role navigates directly to the progress URL, THEN the platform hides the progress data and redirects to the login screen.'
